data.one_liner: Provides a DecoratedIcon widget to add borders and gradients to icons.
data.what_it_does: Adds decoration capabilities to the standard Icon widget via a DecoratedIcon wrapper. You can apply borders, gradients (Web only), and use the Icon's own shadow property. The widget overlays the decoration on the base icon.
use_when: You need simple borders or gradient fills on icons without writing custom painters
You want a drop‑in replacement for Icon that supports extra styling
avoid_when: You require complex animated icon effects
You need shadow support through the decoration API (shadows are now handled by Icon)
You target platforms where gradient support is unavailable (non‑Web)
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just replace Icon with DecoratedIcon
Supports gradient fills on Flutter Web
Leverages existing Icon shadows, keeping API familiar
weaknesses: No longer supports shadows via IconDecoration (must use Icon.shadows)
Limited to icon decoration; not a full UI kit
